oi_proxy.rule: open interest down at least 1.5% while price moves at least 1.0% within one stored step, or a robust z-score of the open-interest change at or below −3 with the price move's z-score at least 2 in size.

limits: Hyperliquid's public info API has no market-wide liquidation feed. Liquidations are those visible in the fills of the 1,000 tracked wallets: their own, or ones their resting orders absorbed. Seen notional is a lower bound.
The open-interest proxy cannot tell a liquidation from a voluntary close; it is an upper bound on forced selling or buying during that step.
Flows compare snapshots taken about every 30 minutes. A position opened and closed between two snapshots is invisible, and a trimmed position means part of it was cut within one step.

Fills are fetched only for wallets whose size in this metal moved by at least $10,000 since the last snapshot (at most 50 per sweep), looking back 4 hours, plus 16 wallets a sweep scanned for liquidation fills (wallets that absorbed liquidations before, then a round-robin through both cohorts).

The worst-performing cohort is ranked by leaderboard month PnL (whole account), while the top cohort uses perp-only month PnL; wallets that change rank between sweeps are left out of that step's flow.
